title: luzula multiflora subsp. pallescens
intro: Luzula multiflora subsp. pallescens, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Juncaceae), is a subspecies of Luzula multiflora. It is a perennial plant native to certain regions in Europe and Asia, known for its pale yellow-green flowers and slender foliage. The health benefits of Luzula multiflora subsp. pallescens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiproliferative effects.
